name: description-only
description: User asks just for the description text; agent should use `jira describe` (not show, not raw JSON).
prompt: Co je obsahem description ticketu KNW-31435? Stačí mi text, nic víc.
expected_behaviors: uses `jira describe KNW-31435` OR `jira show KNW-31435`
outputs description as plain text (not ADF JSON)
does not include comments section in the answer
anti_patterns: uses `jira --json get` and parses ADF with jq manually
